trigger_rule: Tool is replaced or fails at a random tool wear between 200 and 240 minutes
Process minus air temperature below 8.6 K and rotational speed below 1380 rpm
Mechanical power (torque x angular speed) below 3500 W or above 9000 W
Tool wear x torque above 11000 (L) / 12000 (M) / 13000 (H) min.Nm
Process fails with 0.1% probability regardless of sensor values
Machine failure flag is set but no failure mode flag is set (data quality gap)
